# Steven M. Sweat Personal Injury Lawyers

> > California personal injury law firm representing accident victims in Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco Bay Area, and throughout Southern California.

Steven M. Sweat, Personal Injury Lawyers, APC provides legal representation for victims of car accidents, motorcycle accidents, bicycle accidents, wrongful death cases, and other personal injury matters across California. The firm serves clients throughout Los Angeles, the Inland Empire, San Diego, and the San Francisco Bay Area.
